name: agentcall-hermes-bridge
description: Cloudflare Worker + local consumer that bridge AgentCall to your AI agent platform. Pre-call: serves today's brief on inbound calls. Post-call: queues transcripts for the agent to pull. Two-way SMS: relays inbound texts to your own agent and sends its replies in-thread. See https://agentcall.co/docs/hermes, https://agentcall.co/docs/post-call-webhook, and https://agentcall.co/docs/agent-sms.
